text:
ashok: quick question — i'm about to change websvc from a Deployment -> StatefulSet in the infra TF module. goal is to preserve PVCs for sticky caches and handle ordinal startup. plan: replicas 2 -> 3, podManagementPolicy: Parallel, updateStrategy.partition = 1. also secret is mounted from external-secrets (vault sync). any gotchas with services, headless svc, or secret mount paths? should probes/resources change?
maria (infra): headless svc required (+1). StatefulSet relies on stable network ids. also double-check app handles ordinal identity (HOSTNAME). readinessProbe timing tends to matter more with parallel startup.
taylor (sre): fyi if you're running in parallel startup, CPU/ram peaks could spike — set requests conservatively or use startupProbe to avoid flapping. preStop hooks still work but draining semantics differ vs Deployment. if you want safer rollouts use partitioning + manual canary.
nash: @ashok for secret mounting: external-secrets mounts same k8s Secret, path shouldn't change unless you switch to projected volumes. confirm TF doesn't recreate secret resource.
maria (infra): snippet for StatefulSet updateStrategy — put this in the k8s manifest (not TF plan excerpt):
```yaml
updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    partition: 1
replicas: 3
```
note: StatefulSet RollingUpdate doesn't support maxSurge/maxUnavailable like Deployment. partition controls which replicas are updated.
nash: ok — good catch re maxSurge. thanks.
sam (platform): on the terraform side, you'll change resource "kubernetes_stateful_set_v1" "websvc" {
  metadata { name = "websvc" }
  spec {
    replicas = var.web_replicas
    pod_management_policy = "Parallel"
    update_strategy {
      rolling_update { partition = var.rollout_partition }
    }
    volume_claim_template { /* pvc template */ }
  }
}
```
also ensure external-secrets uses the same secret name/namespace so mount path unchanged.
deploy-bot: CI: terraform plan OK (plan id: 4821) — no destructive secret changes detected :white_check_mark:
ash: recommendation — add startupProbe (longer) and bump liveness probe threshold during first N seconds, so new pods don't get killed while initializing caches. also add a brief sleep in preStop to drain connections if you rely on in-flight requests.
maria (infra): add this to the rollout doc? i'll flag the platform runbook: statefulset migration checklist (svc/headless, pvc retention, partition rollout, probes, resource guardrails, verify pv reclaimPolicy).
ash: i'll open PR with TF changes + migration playbook, pinging @maria (infra) and @taylor (sre) for review. thanks everyone :pray:
